proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is creating a persistent adhesive bond between two objects. No existing effect atom models object-to-object bonding or the restricted break conditions that follow from that state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object_pair
proposed_widenings.justification: The current attachment surface can target one object, but Sovereign Glue operates on a pair of objects as the subject of one activation.

proposed_widenings.name: delayed_set_then_persist
proposed_widenings.justification: Applying the glue and having the bond take effect are separated by a one-minute setting delay. The current activation family has immediate phases and optional ongoing duration, but no honest way to defer the bond's application until after the setup window completes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The item fits the magic_item activation family structurally, and its ounce count could plausibly map to a non-recharging consumable pool, but the core mechanic is not representable without inventing a new bonding effect. I also did not model the storage requirement in Oil of Slipperiness or the limited break methods, because forcing a partial placeholder trace here would be misleading.
